protocol.roster: three loads x twenty new real seeds x eight runs = 480 complete runs; per tape v4 once, analytic once, raw Poisson three and mixed successors three
protocol.real_arrivals: one tape per load/real seed, shared by all eight policies/repetitions, then drain its identical full population
protocol.planning_arrivals: frozen aligned-planning:{planning_seed}:{coordinate} streams; raw and mixed start from matched seeds, advance only on active calls and may diverge after changed decisions
protocol.frozen_policy: lane-by-lane mixed successors with q_i/mu_i priority and largest fitting pure profiles; original current candidate pool/support cap, four paid successors, shared Poisson horizon and original-mu fluid tail
protocol.deterministic_controls: v4 and analytic are evaluated once per real tape; their values are reused as matched denominators across planning repetitions

adoption_criteria.independent_unit: real arrival seed; 20 units per load
adoption_criteria.planning_aggregation: arithmetic mean of three matched mixed/raw ratios inside each load and real arrival seed
adoption_criteria.primary_metric: mean flow time through completion of the full arrival population
adoption_criteria.interval: Bonferroni simultaneous two-sided Student-t confidence intervals, df=19
adoption_criteria.no_worsening_rule: upper confidence limit <= 1; zero noninferiority margin
adoption_criteria.primary_confirmation: all three per-load claims must pass

adoption_guardrails.interpretation: predeclared point-estimate adoption thresholds, not additional statistical noninferiority claims

adoption_criteria.adoption: execution integrity, all three primary claims, and every point-estimate guardrail must pass
adoption_criteria.inference_scope: three frozen loads under the model and the three frozen planning streams; Student-t coverage uses the usual arrival-seed sampling assumptions

protocol.cost: every row retains native candidate, bound, pricing, path, RNG and successor work; mixed lane/priority/profile/update subtotals and measured selector time are retained
protocol.source_snapshot: full text companion file written before any fresh tape is generated
protocol.stopping_rule: run all 480 registered cases once; retain all twenty real seeds and three planning repetitions; no tuning, additions or reruns after outcomes

Confirmation concerns the deterministic cached frame model and registered loads; it does not establish live hardware performance.
